case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to rising alloy and material costs, and we take that seriously. Our options give Blankstahl Werdenfels a longer contract term, and that is the basis on which we would like to settle the price.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: the cost lines above have moved down, and Option A gives your firm a longer contract term at a price that reflects that.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Please take Option A to the colleague who decides on pricing on your side, so that we can close this quickly and simply.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed the index data you provided for AS-14404 and PPI-C2431, and we have incorporated these verified market movements into our calculation. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We can accommodate the 24-month contract term and 45-day payment period proposed in your Option A, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material volatility. With this necessary adjustment to the terms, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 5.40. 

Our Angebot is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl

move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You called your offer final, and we have read it as a serious one. Our answer is a serious effort to close: a binding volume for the full term, so your free capacity has a firm basis, and one clear base price that both family companies can plan around.

We have not changed our view on the index clause. Without it, you carry no alloy-linked adjustments to administer, and we both know exactly what each delivery costs.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.06; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.01; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.03; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
